record.name: Planium – AI Travel Planner
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Some trips are planned. The best ones are Planium'd.

Stop spending hours on travel blogs, spreadsheets, and Google Maps tabs. Planium builds your perfect trip in seconds — then gets out of your way so you can actually enjoy it.

YOUR ITINERARY, BUILT BY AI
Tell us where you're going. Planium does the rest. A smart, day-by-day plan lands in seconds — optimized for time, distance, and the places actually worth visiting. Want to change something? Edit freely. Add stops, remove places, rearrange your whole day. It's your trip.

THAT POST YOU SAVED IS NOW A PLAN
Share an Instagram post to Planium and it reads the places mentioned in it, finds them, and drops them into your trip. The restaurant you saved three months ago finally gets used.

EVERY GREAT PLACE, IN ONE APP
Restaurants that locals love. Museums with stories behind them. Hidden rooftops, peaceful parks, buzzing nightlife. Planium curates the best of every city so you never waste a day on the wrong choice. Check photos, opening hours, ticket prices, and real details before you go.

ASK SOMEONE WHO'S BEEN THERE
Some questions a blog will never answer. Is that neighbourhood fine after dark? Is the rooftop worth the queue? Ask travelers who just got back — then answer someone else when it's your turn. Post a tip, share a plan others can copy, or start a poll when nobody can decide.

HEAR THE CITY COME ALIVE
Turn on the audio guide and let Planium narrate each place as you explore. Rich voice narration brings the history, culture, and character of every spot to life — no reading required.

KNOW BEFORE YOU BOOK
Add the passports you hold and see exactly what each destination asks of you. Visa-free, visa on arrival, or apply ahead — answered before you buy the ticket.

PACK FOR THE WEATHER YOU'LL ACTUALLY GET
Planium builds your packing list from what the city is really like in the month you're going. Nobody needs to arrive carrying a coat they will never wear.

SEE YOUR WHOLE DAY AT A GLANCE
Every stop on your plan appears on the map. See exactly how far each place is from the next, spot the smartest route, and move through your day with zero confusion. The map shows which way you're facing, so you start walking in the right direction.

DISCOVER WHAT'S AROUND YOU RIGHT NOW
Open Nearby and find great places within 50km of wherever you are — filtered exactly the way you want, down to whether you'll need a reservation. Perfect for spontaneous moments.

BRING THE WHOLE CREW
Invite friends to your plan and build the trip together. Share the excitement before you even pack your bags.

AND SETTLE UP WITHOUT THE AWKWARD PART
Track what the trip costs, add everyone who's in, and let Planium work out each person's share. No spreadsheet, no arguments at the airport. Everyone on the trip can follow what it's costing — you decide who gets to add to it.

COLLECT THE CITIES YOU VISIT
Every trip earns experience and city badges, and your passport fills up as you travel. Take a city quiz to prove how well you really know the place.

STAY IN THE LOOP
Track upcoming events in every city so you never miss something worth showing up for.

SAVE IT. SHARE IT.
Add places you love to your favorites and share your lists with other travelers. Follow people whose taste you trust and let their plans inspire your next adventure.

NO SIGNAL? NO STRESS.
Export your full plan to PDF before you go. Your itinerary travels with you, online or off.

LOOK AROUND FIRST
No wall, no form. Open Planium and explore the cities, the places, and what other travelers are saying before you decide to make an account.

Download Planium. Travel smarter.

Turn the places you save into a real trip.

You see a restaurant you'd actually book on Instagram, a hidden beach on TikTok, a cafe a creator swears by. Then it's gone, buried in screenshots, saved Reels, and a messy Notes list. Batootah pulls all of it into one place and lets AI build the itinerary for you.

No more planning trips from a chaotic Google Doc. Save as you scroll, and let Batootah do the rest.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
Share any reel, video, or map link straight to batootah. We automatically pull in the location from Instagram, TikTok, Google Maps, or your own notes, so the spot is saved the moment you find it. Paste a link, hit share, or drop in your own note - if there's a place in it, Batootah finds it. No copying addresses, no jumping between apps, no losing track of that one spot you wanted to try.

TRIPS FROM CREATORS YOU TRUST
The best travel advice comes from people who've actually been there. Batootah keeps every recommendation tied to the creator you saved it from, so your trip is built on people who've stood in the room and eaten the food, not anonymous reviews. Follow the creators whose taste matches yours and let their real experiences shape where you go.

ORGANIZE INTO TRIP BOARDS
Group everything you save into boards by city, vibe, or trip. Planning a weekend in Lisbon, a food tour of Tokyo, and a someday list of dream stays all at once? Keep them separate and always in sync. Your travel wishlist lives in one place instead of scattered across screenshots and group chats.

AI ITINERARY IN SECONDS
Pick a destination and your dates, tap "Plan trip with AI," and Batootah turns your saved spots into an optimized, day-by-day itinerary instantly. Smart routing groups nearby places together, so you spend less time backtracking and more time actually traveling. Every plan is yours to tweak: move spots between days, drop the ones you're not feeling, and add new finds as you go.

SEE IT ALL ON THE MAP
View every saved spot on a live map, filtered by trip, day, or category, so you always know what's worth visiting nearby. Land somewhere new and instantly see which of your saved places are within walking distance.

ONE HOME BASE FOR EVERY PLACE
Every spot you've ever saved, in one organized, searchable place. Search by name, city, or category to pull up any place in seconds. Your travel library grows with every trip, ready for the next one and the one after that.

WHAT MAKES BATOOTAH DIFFERENT
Most travel apps hand you a blank search bar and a million strangers' opinions. It starts with the places you already saved, from the people you already trust. You're not guessing whether a spot is worth it, because you bookmarked it yourself from a creator who was actually there. AI handles the tedious part — turning that pile of saved places into a sensible plan for each day. It feels like a trip planned by a friend with great taste, not an algorithm.

BUILT BY A TRAVEL CREATOR

PERFECT FOR
- Travelers who save far more Reels than they ever revisit
- Anyone tired of planning trips across 10 open tabs and a Notes app
- People who'd rather follow trusted creators than sift through reviews
- Foodies hunting down the restaurants worth flying for
- First-timers who want a local's plan without hiring a guide
- Weekend getaways, big international trips, and everything in between

HOW IT WORKS
1. Save as you scroll - share spots from Instagram, TikTok & Google Maps
2. Build a trip board - organize by city, vibe, or trip
3. Let batootah plan it - get a day-by-day AI itinerary in seconds

Your next trip deserves better than a Google Doc. Download batootah and turn your saved spots into a real itinerary today.
Reach us at hello@batootah.com

record.name: DreamTrips AI
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
DreamTrips turns planning a trip into a conversation. Tell Alfred, your travel concierge, where you're going and how you like to travel — slow mornings or first in the queue — and he writes the days out for you.

Not a search box. Something closer to a friend who has already been.

TELL HIM THE TRIP

Describe it the way you'd say it out loud: "Four days in Lisbon, nothing before ten, we love seafood." Alfred builds the full day-by-day itinerary — breakfast, the landmark, the walk between them, lunch, what to do before dinner. Choose a persona, set the pace, tell him what you're into, and he reshapes the plan whenever you change your mind.

SEE THE TRIP BEFORE YOU TAKE IT

Your itinerary lands on a 3D globe, each day in its own colour. Tap a day and the camera flies to that day's stops. It answers "is this too much walking?" faster than any list can, and tells you at a glance whether Tuesday is a gentle wander or a city-wide sprint.

BOOK SOME OF IT, COMPARE THE REST

- Hotels: live availability and member pricing, booked inside the app, cancellation supported. Payment is completed on a secure hosted checkout page.
- Attractions and tickets, reserved ahead so the queue is someone else's morning.
- Restaurants with photos, ratings, price level and the tips that actually matter.
- Concerts, matches and shows worth building an evening around.
- Flights: real routes, times and fares to compare. Flight booking is not available in this release.

THE TRAVEL WALLET

A gate change at 6:40 a.m. A boarding pass you need in a terminal with no signal. Boarding passes, insurance and visas live in one place, with QR codes that scan offline — because airport Wi-Fi is not a plan.

Your passport expiry gets a reminder before it becomes someone else's problem at a border. Live flight status shows terminal, gate and delay. Visa requirements for where you're headed. A shortcut to Find My for the bag you're not sure made the connection.

ASK OUT LOUD, OR JUST POINT

Speak to Alfred and he answers aloud. A landmark you can't name. A dish you can't pronounce. Take the photo and ask him what it is.

EIGHT LANGUAGES

Each one written and spoken in a voice that sounds native rather than translated.

WHAT STAYS ON YOUR PHONE

Home address, date of birth and passport number are stored only on your device and never reach our servers. Card details never pass through our systems. No ads and no in-app purchases.

MEMBERSHIP

DreamTrips AI is built for members of the DreamTrips travel club. Sign-in is required and accounts come through the club, so the app is not open to general signup.

Location-based suggestions are optional and stay off until you turn them on. Push notifications keep trip reminders on time. Rated 18+ because conversations with Alfred are open-ended, and because he is an AI: double-check anything time-critical, since opening hours, visa rules and schedules change.

record.description_evidence:
Pack Papi is an AI-powered travel packing list app that creates personalized packing checklists for every trip in seconds.

Instead of using generic packing lists, Pack Papi analyzes your destination, real-time weather, trip length, activities, travel style, and group context to generate a smart packing list tailored specifically for you.

Whether you're planning a weekend trip, business travel, beach vacation, ski trip, or international trip, Pack Papi helps you pack the right items and avoid overpacking.

HOW PACK PAPI WORKS

Pack Papi uses a powerful multi-layer system:

• Smart Rule Engine — Calculates exactly what you need based on trip duration, weather, laundry access, baggage type, and activities  
• AI Personalization — Adds destination-specific recommendations, cultural insights, and smart suggestions  
• Real-Time Weather Intelligence — Adjusts your packing list automatically based on live forecasts  

KEY FEATURES

• AI-generated packing lists in seconds  
• Weather-aware recommendations  
• Smart quantity calculations  
• Duplicate item detection  
• Pack Light mode to reduce overpacking  
• Multi-destination trip support  
• Group trips with real-time collaboration  
• Join trips using simple codes  
• Photo packing verification (AI checks your suitcase)  
• Family mode with age-based recommendations  
• Emergency info storage (works offline)  
• Packing progress tracking  

SMART GROUP TRAVEL

Collaborate with friends and family using shared packing lists:
• Join trips with a code  
• See what others are packing  
• Avoid duplicates  
• Live presence (see who’s active)  

PERFECT FOR

• Travel packing  
• Vacation planning  
• Business trips  
• Carry-on packing  
• Minimalist travel  
• Family trips  
• Group travel  

PACK SMARTER

Stop guessing what to pack. Pack Papi builds a personalized packing list so you always bring the right things.

Download Pack Papi and pack smarter for every trip.

record.name: Turizmo: AI Travel Planner
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Turizmo – Travel Your Way
Whether you’re heading out for the afternoon, taking a weekend road trip, moving your kid into college, attending a destination wedding, planning a golf getaway or traveling across the world – Turizmo keeps you in control.
Tell Turizmo where you’re going, when you’re going and what you’d like to experience. You'll get support turning those ideas into an organized travel plan complete with important details — places, reservations, flights, hotels, transportation, contacts, notes, maps and more — together in one place.
You can also bring information you already have into Turizmo. Import booking details for transportation, hotels and attraction tickets, or bring in travel inspiration from platforms such as YouTube, Instagram and TikTok by sharing a video link or travel agenda.
Turizmo helps you shape your ideas into an organized itinerary built around your priorities. You can edit and adapt your plans to any circumstances, so you remain in control.

And that’s when IZ comes in.

IZ is your intelligent travel companion, ready to help you explore possibilities, answer questions, refine your itinerary and help you adapt as your journey evolves.

Ask IZ to find something different, rearrange your day, mix in travel companion suggestions, suggest attractions, research a destination or help you figure out what to do next. IZ can use your imported videos as inspiration to help create an itinerary built around your trip.

Because plans change.
Weather changes. Flights get delayed. Friends change their minds. You discover a place you didn’t know existed. Sometimes you simply decide you’d rather do something else – Turizmo is designed for that.

Turizmo also helps you stay informed with live alerts for weather, geological events, public safety, health or epidemic concerns, and conflict or war alerts relevant to your journey.

Everything about your trip. Together.
Keep the important details of your journey organized in one place:
- Itineraries and daily plans
- Flights, trains, ferries and ships
- Hotels and other accommodations
- Transportation details, including rental car information added to your trip notes
- Confirmation and reservation numbers
- Flight numbers and gate information
- Addresses and contact information
- Attractions, restaurants, museums, concerts, sporting events and shopping
- Packing lists and trip notes
- Destination weather information
- Local police and hospital information
- Live weather, geological, public safety, health and conflict alerts
- Maps and directions
- Post photos, videos and travel memories
- Share trips and posts with family, friends and the community

Plan it. Then adapt.
Build your initial itinerary and change it whenever you want. Edit it yourself or talk with IZ about what you’d like to change.
Move an activity. Find another restaurant. Change the order of your day. Add a stop. Remove one. Ask for ideas. Rework tomorrow because the weather changed.

Turizmo’s adaptive travel intelligence helps your plans evolve with your journey instead of forcing you to start over.

Travel together.
Share your travel plan with friends already on Turizmo or invite people from your contacts. Give fellow travelers review-only access when you simply want to keep everyone informed, or invite them to edit the trip with you so plans can develop together.

Your trip doesn’t end with the itinerary.
Turizmo stays useful before, during and after your journey. Organize the details, coordinate with travel companions, stay informed, capture photos and video, privately or publicly share experiences with the Turizmo community, and archive your journeys. From a day trip to a multi-country vacation, Turizmo gives you one place to plan, organize, adapt and remember the experience.

Wherever you’re going, travel your way.
